## Story DD Coverage
Prerequisite for DD1, DD2, DD5 — must execute BEFORE any corpus file commits. Without this entry, the plugin-boundary pre-commit hook blocks all plugins/dso/data/ commits.

## Context
.claude/hooks/pre-commit/plugin-boundary-allowlist.conf controls which paths under plugins/ are allowed to receive commits. The corpus directory plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/ does not yet appear there.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `plugins/dso/data/**` entry present in .claude/hooks/pre-commit/plugin-boundary-allowlist.conf
- [ ] Existing allowlist entries unchanged
- [ ] chmod +x not required (config file, not a script)

## Given/When/Then
GIVEN the plugin-boundary pre-commit hook is active
WHEN a file is committed to plugins/dso/data/
THEN the hook allows the commit without error

## Retry Budget: 3
data.title: Add plugins/dso/data/** to plugin-boundary-allowlist.conf
